definitions.gloss: archipelago, island chain, chain of islands
definitions.explanation: A group of islands arranged in a line or arc. Most commonly used to refer to Japan as an island chain.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{列島|れっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{南北|なんぼく}→南北：04287_nanboku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese archipelago is long from north to south.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{列島|れっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon passed through the archipelago from end to end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{列島|れっとう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{多数|たすう}→多数：05612_tasuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{構成|こうせい}→構成：02729_kousei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Japanese archipelago is made up of four large islands and numerous small ones.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line) + {島|とう} (island). Most commonly encountered in the phrase ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{列島|れっとう} (the Japanese archipelago).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧{列島|れっとう} (the Japanese archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{縦断|じゅうだん}→縦断：09035_juudan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to traverse the archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧ (the entire archipelago)
- {列島|れっとう}⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧ (various parts of the archipelago)

USAGE:
In weather forecasts and news, {列島|れっとう} alone often refers to Japan: {列島|れっとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{寒波|かんぱ}→寒波：12354_kanpa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{到来|とうらい}→到来：11788_tourai⟧ (a cold wave hits the archipelago = Japan). This usage is so common that the word is strongly associated with Japan in everyday Japanese.
